none: PAS FindID 1006371: Lin-6079FA: Roman nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I (AD. 306-337), dating to AD 310-315 (Reece Period 15). SOLI INVICTO COMITI reverse type, depicting Sol standing left, chlamys draped over left shoulder, right raised, left holding up globe. Mint of Trier. RIC Vol. VI, pg. 227, no. 870. Obverse description: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse description: Sol standing left holding globe in left hand and raising right hand; chlamys across left shoulder. Reverse inscription: SOLI IN[VICTO COMITI]. Mint Mark: BTR. Thickness: 1.65 mm. Weight: 1.86g. Diameter: 18.81 mm
